lines: The giant spider's shrill cry sounded like iron nails scratched against a blackboard.
Countless strands of silk then shot from its wide-open mouth radiating outward.
Spread out!! Don't get caught in the spider's web!!
The Taimanin, who'd been about to gang up on Saburo, abruptly scattered.
The webbing fanned out from the demonic spider's mouth and chased after the fleeing Taimanin as if each strand had a will of its own.
And once it caught its prey, the spider silk then wrapped them up in a flash.
Some had tried to fend them off with their katana, but the super adhesive strands even snatched them away from their hands.
The demonic spider gleefully manipulated the webbing with its mouth and flung the captured Taimanin to hang every single one of them upside down from trees.
Wrapped in spider silk from the neck down, the Taimainin all looked like moth cocoons as they swayed pathetically in the air.
Leave one of them alive. You can eat the rest, Daigoro.
Saburo murmured in a cold voice that didn't match her adorable face.
The demonic spider was looking over at each of the Taimanin as the stench of its breath washed over them, wondering which to eat first.
The Taimanin who had succumbed to his fear and let out a shriek was the first victim to be chosen.
Daigoro opened its mouth and bit into his head.
However, it did not crush his skull.
Instead, leaving him alive it sank its fangs into his brain and then began injecting its venom.
The body of the Taimanin began to spasm as if to dance a bizarre dance.
The spider's poison would course through its victim's entire body while melting their flesh and bone.
However, their brain itself was left intact until the very end.
As a result, demonic spider's prey were forced to be conscious of their bodies being melted and sucked away right up until their death.
Saburo knew that their fear was Daigoro's favorite spice.
The Taimanin was melted and eaten alive, and even his brain was slurped up at the end.
And only his flimsy skin was tossed aside like garbage.
The Taimanin began to scream in unison as they witnessed the horrific death of their comrade. A death that they would soon experience.
L-Let me go!! Don't kill meeee!!
No!! I don't wanna die like thaaat!!!
Waaaaaaagh!!! Captain!! Do something, please! Captaaaiiin!!
Taimanin begging for their lives? Pathetic.
Saburo stared coldly at the pleading men with the same red eyes as her demonic spider.
Why don't you say something, Captain-san?
Ghngh...! Y-You can eat me!! Just spare my men!!
Shinobi who know no shame don't deserve to live.
Saburo swung her katana and cut the throat of one of the men who'd been screaming.
They don't even deserve to be Daigoro's meal either.
She cut off one head after another.
Eventually, except for the captain who tried to save his subordinates at the cost of his own life, Saburo had removed the heads of all the remaining Taimanin.
I'll let you go. And you'll be the one to let all know the terror of the new "Onigumo Saburo."
Having only eaten one Taimanin, a somewhat dissatisfied looking Daigoro spat more webbing from its mouth.
It wrapped up the captain's face, and he struggled for a while, but he eventually stopped moving.
『Ahaha! Still the same old same old Saburo, eh?』
The cheerful voice of a young boy, so out of place at this gruesome execution site, echoed through the area.
Saburo spoke, still facing the headless bodies left hanging from the trees.
Suddenly, a boy emerged from the shadows of dangling corpses.
He was one of the underbosses who were in service to the Nisha Family, one of the Eight Generals of the Fuma.
His age seemed about the same as Saburo's.
In contrast to her pale features, his cheeks were tinged with rose pink. They were both as beautiful and handsome as dolls in different ways.
An amiable smile played about his face despite the bizarreness of the fact that he'd appeared out of the shadows of the corpses.
We're going home. You've angered Gaiza-sama.
Saburo spoke without so much as a smile.
No way. I'm going to kill the head of the Fuma with my own hand.
Shizuku playfully swung his claw weapons in disagreement like a child playing with his favorite toys.
The energy blades of his claws traced brilliant trails of light in the air.
Tell that to Gaiza-sama, can you? My mission is just to bring you back, Shizuku.
Saburo replied coldly as if to say she couldn't care less.
Shizuku frowned, his face now filled with displeasure.
I don't wanna! I'm gonna prove that the Gosha Taimanin are no match for me.
Gonza the butler aside, I can't understand why Gaiza-sama treats me like I'm his third or fourth choice!
And if this is considered mutiny against Gaiza-sama?
The two of them had been arguing like children fighting, but then Saburo's tone of voice suddenly lowered with seriousness.
All I want is to prove my strength!
Saburo's red eyes fixed their gaze on Shizuku.
The demonic spider let out a sharp cry.
The spider's webbing that had wiped out the Taimanin closed in on Shizuku at a tremendous speed.
The moment the strand seemed to have caught Shizuku's body...
Shizuku vanished into thin air as silently and abruptly as when he first appeared.
『Ahaha! I won't go back. Not until I've eliminated the Master Diot!』
Only the echo of his innocent laughter lingered in the air, and soon that could no longer be heard either.
